agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse's AlignedIndentFilter._process_case (sqlparse/filters/aligned_indent.py): the CASE statement's closing END keyword was incorrectly aligned flush with WHEN/ELSE branches instead of being de-indented to the CASE keyword's column. Added a special case so END uses self.nl() with no branch offset, restoring correct alignment for 'format reindent aligned: basic', 'case statement', and 'case statement with between' while preserving all other reindent_aligned behavior (joins, group/order by, having, subqueries verified manually).
